plans.name: Moderato
plans.billing: Monthly or annual; credits refresh each month
plans.note: Agent credit values are approximate and based on typical task token consumption. Monthly credits are converted to the equivalent number of tasks for the same feature, for reference only. Membership features share a single credit pool metered by token usage. Kimi Code has a separate 5-hour/weekly rate limit, but this page does not state its numeric allowance.
